about: Labeled relevance cases for scoring/relevance.ts and lib/location.ts, scored against server/data/profile.json. Each case asserts expected.tier and expected.isIndia. Add a failing case here before changing the profile or the algorithm (ARCHITECTURE.md, Relevance).
